nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) can start like a cold but escalate quickly in vulnerable groups. If you have severe symptoms like difficulty breathing or chest discomfort, get tested early. Protect yourself & your loved ones. Visit Sakra World Hospital today!
